stories.title: Dozens arrested after fatal pre-dawn shootout in Dutch village
stories.summary: Police urged people in Overasselt to stay indoors after one person died and 34 were arrested Authorities have arrested 34 people, including French, Belgian and Algerian nationals, after a person died in a pre-dawn shootout in a Dutch village reportedly linked to a notorious drug lord. Police urged people in Overasselt, near the German border, to stay indoors with doors and windows shut in case further suspects were on the loose. Continue reading...
stories.headline: Dozens arrested after fatal pre-dawn shootout in Dutch village

opening: Police urged people in Overasselt to stay indoors after one person died and 34 were arrested.
Authorities have arrested 34 people, including French, Belgian and Algerian nationals, after a person died in a pre-dawn shootout in a Dutch village reportedly linked to a notorious drug lord.
body: Police urged people in Overasselt, near the German border, to stay indoors with doors and windows shut in case further suspects were on the loose.
